text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion raced through the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks). Bathed in the cheers of her fans, 
she savored the pure joy of running...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's joyful running seemed to 
leave a lasting impression on the heart of 
the Umamusume she spoke with before the 
race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet Fine Motion found herself perplexed. 
Surrounded by Umamusume running for 
various distinct reasons, she wondered 
about her own inner "instinct" that found 
pure joy in the act of running itself...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite a faint nagging feeling, she 
looked forward to the summer training 
camp. Waiting after the camp was the Shuka 
Sho...
